# pve_acme_certificate (Data Source)

Reads a node's ACME certificate registration (the `acme` entry of `GET /nodes/{node}/config`) and the certificate deployed for it (`GET /nodes/{node}/certificates/info`). The certificate fields are null when no ACME certificate is currently deployed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright IBM Corp. 2021, 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "pve_acme_certificate" "pve1" {
  node = "pve1"
}

output "pve1_acme_domains" {
  value = data.pve_acme_certificate.pve1.domains
}

output "pve1_acme_not_after" {
  value = data.pve_acme_certificate.pve1.not_after
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Read-Only

- `domains` (List of String) Domains registered in the node's `acme` configuration entry. Empty when the node has no ACME registration.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA 256 fingerprint of the deployed certificate.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source; equals the `node` name.
- `issuer` (String) Certificate issuer name.
- `not_after` (Number) Certificate notAfter timestamp (UNIX epoch).
- `not_before` (Number) Certificate notBefore timestamp (UNIX epoch).
- `public_key_bits` (Number) Certificate public key size in bits.
- `public_key_type` (String) Certificate public key algorithm (e.g. `rsa`).
- `san` (List of String) SubjectAlternativeName entries of the deployed certificate.
- `subject` (String) Certificate subject name.
